learning.claim: Validation learning trajectories and checkpoint selection are visible.
learning.evidence: Recorded epoch histories; one training seed, no interval.
learning.export: 7.2 x 3.2 inches; editable SVG and 300 DPI PNG
learning.choice: Line plot because epochs are ordered; alternative is epoch points.

detectors.claim: The benefit of pooling depends on the evaluation domain.
detectors.evidence: Frozen-checkpoint pooled F1 and 95% percentile intervals from 1000 scene/panorama bootstrap replicates.
detectors.export: 7.2 x 3.4 inches; editable SVG and 300 DPI PNG
detectors.choice: Point/interval plot exposes estimation uncertainty; alternatives: paired difference plot or numeric table.

policy.claim: Average policy value can conceal harmful individual follow-ups.
policy.evidence: Scene-level gains from three actual simulator acquisitions; points retain every observation, diamond means, box IQR, whiskers 1.5 IQR.
policy.export: 7.2 x 3.7 inches; editable SVG and 300 DPI PNG
policy.choice: Box/strip plot preserves dispersion; alternatives: gain histogram or empirical CDF.
